rows.html:
Future of the P2P invoicing process supported by AI
• Vendor query management
• Duplicate invoice trace
• Vendor reconciliation
• Exception handling
• Common collector mailbox
Decision question: How many platforms are needed in the interim before UNIFY, and what is the target model after UNIFY and Titan?
Decommissioning risk and technical debt created by the interim solution

Identified interim-solution needs
• Deploy 3 AI agents for invoice exception handling after APS OCR failures in legacy FERPs
• Agent 1 is in production; integration design and cost estimation for Agents 2 and 3 are ongoing
• Validate the FERP implementation exception through Design Authority
• Keep on hold until budget is validated, with action on Digital Finance
• Investigate Galvanize for UNIFY duplicate-payment checks until Xelix or Oversight goes live in July 2027; bring the non-best-of-breed integration topic to Enterprise Architecture
Not interim solutions
• Xelix/Oversight for VQM, duplicate-payment optimization and vendor statement reconciliation
• Common collector mailbox is deprioritized for 2026
The principle is to use the same technology everywhere. The investigation of standards for KunPeng has not yet been conducted.
China uses local invoice-management applications that support regulatory requirements. The remaining point is the strategy for Taiwan and Hong Kong.
